args.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset: ONE single landscape 4:3 iPad game-view target illustration, ideally 2048 x 1536 PNG, not a collage, diagram, screenshot or image sheet. Create a completely NEW scene.
Reference roles: Image 1 is the APPROVED #807 target for visual quality, sunny light, color, architecture materials and the Puyi costume ONLY. Do NOT copy its close camera, face turned back, action blur or loading-screen composition. Image 2 is the exact Puyi REAR identity reference: one centered black braid, black hat with red crown and gold finial, golden robe AND separate golden cape with blue-gray dragon/cloud embroidery and wave hem, dark trousers and black pale-soled boots. Image 3 is the existing GAME DRONE CAMERA scale/viewing-direction guide ONLY, not the final-quality target or exact scene layout. Omit its cauldrons, planters, benches and low-detail materials.
MANDATORY CAMERA: the actual gameplay tracking-drone viewpoint, around 4 to 6 meters above the ground, behind Puyi, looking DOWN and FORWARD along his running direction. A high oblique rear view, not ground-level, not a close portrait, not an overhead plan. Puyi runs AWAY from the viewer, centered near the LOWER CENTER (x=50%, feet around y=87%), SMALL in the composition, about 13 to 17 percent of total image height. See the back of his head, his ONE braid and cape; no over-the-shoulder look or visible smiling face in these gameplay views. Show much more environment than character.
Visual quality: match the approved #807 polished, beautiful stylized 3D game illustration and sun direction. Saturated rich RED palace plaster ABOVE a clearly visible continuous GRAY STONE lower wall/plinth, yellow glazed roof tiles and detailed roof brackets, light gray stone paving with readable individual slab joints, warm direct daytime sun, blue sky, plausible grounded contact shadows. Materials have clear natural variation without noisy invented surface patterns. The gray stone band must be visible in the foreground walls, not covered over with red plaster.
All surfaces are sharp and inspectable throughout the image: absolutely NO motion blur, NO speed streaks, NO shallow-depth-of-field blur, no soft-focus walls. Puyi is also sharp. The route is empty and passable except for the explicitly requested fixed threshold in scene 5.
Only ONE Puyi. No eunuchs, guards, other people, collectibles, coins, pickups, signage, captions, writing, logos, watermarks, loading title, controls, HUD or visible drone. Do not invent extra ornamental objects along the route. No broken, collapsed, exploded or floating architecture. No model files, only a finished 2D image.

Scene 1 / STARTING ALLEY: a narrow straight lane between two rows of LOW, modest palace servants' rooms, one story tall. Both rows have repeated wooden red doors and small Chinese lattice windows, RED plaster walls with clearly exposed GRAY STONE lower courses, and low yellow glazed tile roofs. The camera looks forward between the rows from the gameplay drone position. Door/window modules and roof edges are clearly visible from above and from the sides. Puyi is small at lower center and runs away along the empty light stone-paved lane. Keep this a small-scale residential palace service lane, not giant fortress walls or a grand public avenue. No benches or props outdoors.
Final check: single wide 4:3 GAMEPLAY image, small back-facing running emperor at lower center, elevated rear camera, clearly visible GRAY stone wall bases, all surfaces sharp, NO motion blur, no writing.
